with_doc.title: Reward your members
with_doc.claim_to_use: Funding your campaign with DOC is 20% cheaper and earns you Asami tokens when your campaigns appreciate members. DOC is a fully decentralized stablecoin on the Rootstock blockchain, so you’ll need a compatible wallet — like Beexo, MetaMask, Enkrypt, or Rabby — to use it.

with_doc.form_title: What to know before you launch.
with_doc.service_summary:
Your campaign will go live as soon as it’s submitted. Your wallet may ask for DOC spending authorization before it can proceed.
Repost campaigns run for a fixed 20 days and settle during the last 5 days. Community giveaway campaigns gather their recipients from your community and assign rewards according to score.
Please note: there are no refunds — even if you're not satisfied with the results. We recommend starting with a small 30 DOC budget to see how Asami works for your community.
with_doc.continue_warning: Please ensure you do not pay twice. If your wallet indicates that you have already made the payment, just wait for us to receive your payment notification from the blockchain—there’s no need to pay again. If the campaign publishing process was interrupted, for example, due to insufficient funds or wallet errors, it’s safe to try paying again. Always verify with your wallet: if it shows that you have paid, then your payment is confirmed.

about_us.privacy_statement_title: We have an important privacy statement to make.
privacy_statement: As part of our commitment to fostering a transparent, trustworthy, and fair club, we have specific policies regarding member data that you should be aware of before joining or applying.

1. Access to Participant Information Upon joining, please be informed that all participants will have access to certain details about other participants and their interactions within the club. This includes social media handles, rewards received, campaigns created, and their vote in governance aspects.

2. Permanence of Data: It is crucial to our community's integrity that we maintain a permanent record of interactions and member details. Therefore, once you provide any information to the club, it will be retained indefinitely in the RSK blockchain.

3. No Option for Erasure or Amendment: Please understand that once your data is submitted to the club, you will not have the option to erase or amend this information. This is in line with our policy of maintaining a lasting record for transparency and fairness among all members. It is also a technical impediment arising from the usage of a public blockchain network which replicates data worldwide.

4. Public Availability and Potential Risks: By agreeing to join our club, you acknowledge and consent that all data you provide will be made publicly available worldwide, in perpetuity. We advise you to consider the potential impact this could have on your privacy and reputation.

5. Informed Consent: Your decision to join the club or apply to its waitlist signifies your acceptance of these terms. We believe this policy is essential to attract communities and members who value transparency, ensure fair treatment for all, and maintain trust inside the club.
Please take a moment to consider these points carefully. By joining or applying to ASAMI you agree to these terms regarding your data.
about_us.data_rights_title: About this website and your data rights.
data_rights: This website serves as an interface for engaging with the ASAMI smart contract and participating in the club. The personal information we collect from you is solely for these purposes.
Given the worldwide nature of the public blockchain that enforces the ASAMI smart contract between participants, you must consent to permanetly disclose and store your data globally.
This means you'll be transferring your data to jurisdictions outside the european union that have no data protection guarantees.

You may not be able to have your data amended, or deleted. Your full history of interactions with other participants such as members, campaign creators, votes, and collected rewards may be publicly available to anyone, forever.

If you have questions about the risks associated with global blockchain disclosure, or concerns related to data protection in aspects managed by this website, please reach out through the community channels: X at @asami_club or @asami_club_es, or Telegram at @asami_club or @asami_club_es.

welcome.title: Merging accounts
welcome.title_1: Your old Asami account will be merged into this one.
welcome.text_1: After the merge, you’ll be able to access this unified account using your X handle, your email, or this wallet — whichever method you had set up before. If your old account had a wallet linked, you won’t be able to use that wallet to log in anymore. Any RBTC, ASAMI, or DOC in that wallet will stay there — you’ll need to move those funds manually if you want them in your new wallet.
welcome.title_2: You’ll need to confirm the merge from your old account.
welcome.text_2: We’ll generate a secure link that you need to open while logged in with your old account — ideally from a different device where the session is already active. If that’s not an option, you can log out here and log in with your old account temporarily.
welcome.text_3: The merge must be approved from the old account to protect against abuse. Make sure to claim any unclaimed rewards (ASAMI or DOC) in your old account before continuing, as you won’t be able to access those rewards after merging.
